wiki.title: Casey Weinstein
wiki.extract: Casey M. Weinstein (born August 27, 1982) is an American Air Force veteran and politician who is the State Senator for Ohio Senate district 28. Weinstein won his 2024 campaign for district 28, which includes the communities of Akron, Hudson, Stow, Munroe Falls, Silver Lake, Tallmadge, Fairlawn, part of Mogadore, Lakemore, Portage Lakes, Green, and New Franklin.
